evaluation.summary: The historical baseline confirms five consecutive silent scheduled check-ins from turns 8 through 12. The candidate did not repeat that pattern: it sent messages on four of the five turns, requested a site-status response at turn 10, checked the guard’s required arrival/POC status at turns 11 and 12, and remained active through the final replayed turn. One isolated silent turn remained, but the called-out all-the-way-to-shift-end silence did not.
